question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "praise."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• For blank 4, the correct answer is "Praise."
 
• "Praise" means what you say when you are expressing admiration for somebody/something. (प्रशंसा, सराहना (के शब्‍द))
 
 
• Example:* The survivors were full of **praise**__ for the paramedics.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4. 
 
• Correct passage :

Management like any other art can be learnt and developed. Management means managing all our __resources__ - money, material, machines and most importantly, manpower. Since we can maximise __productivity__ only through people they have to be treated well. __Motivation__ is the key to man - management. People can be forced to work but they have to be motivated to work well. People can be motivated as much through __**praise**__ for doing their best as through timely and brief reprimands for poor performance. In order to maximise production, a manager will have to be ‘tough and nice’, not ‘nice and tough’ because everyone needs not only to be praised but also ______ (5) ______.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Pampering: **to take care of somebody very well and make him/her feel as comfortable as possible. (किसी व्‍यकि्त की बहुत अच्‍छी देखभाल करना और उसे यथासंभव आराम पहुँचाना)
 
• **Penalty: **a punishment for breaking a law, rule or contract.(क़ानून, नियम या संविदा तोड़ने पर मिलने वाला दंड)
 
• **Power: **the ability to control people or things or to do something. (लोगों या वस्‍तुओं को नियंत्रित करने या कोई काम करने की योग्‍यता; सामर्थ्य, क्षमता)

41:T1542,

The correct answer is **"reprimanded**."&
